# FAW Besturn X80 Knowledge Base

Community-sourced knowledge for the FAW Besturn X80 car, trilingual (en at /, ar at /ar/, ru at /ru/), every fact attributed to its original Telegram author. Sources are Russian owner communities: prices are Russian-market (RUB) at the stated dates. Media (images/videos) carry full text descriptions and transcripts in-page — no need to process media files.

## Indexes

- Symptoms & OBD codes: /symptoms/
- Part numbers: /part-numbers/
- Tags: /tags/
- Glossary of Russian jargon: /glossary/
- Sources & freshness: /sources/

- [VIN location — windshield vs. door jamb](/overview/vin-location-and-visibility/) (52 sources, updated 2026-07-24): Most FAW X80 units do not have a clearly visible or readable VIN embossed on the windshield, despite the owner's manual indicating one should be present there. - [Pre-facelift vs. facelift identification](/overview/generations-facelift-identification/) (24 sources, updated 2026-07-20): The FAW X80 exists in two visual generations, referred to in the community by their Russian shorthand: Pre-Restyling / Pre-facelift (Дорестайлинг, до-рест) and Restyling / Facelift (Рестайлинг, рест).

The floor pan is sourced from the Mazda CX-5; interior components (dashboard, panels) come…

- [Infotainment video playback format](/overview/video-multimedia-playback/) (3 sources, updated 2026-09-10): The factory infotainment head unit plays video files in MP4 format — confirmed by an owner who loaded downloaded cartoons for his daughter to watch on road trips .
